\# DeepSeek Vision\: How to Use Image Input with DeepSeek

Last reviewed\: October 9\, 2026

DeepSeek Vision is best understood as DeepSeek’s current image\-input capability in the API\, served throughdeepseek\-flash\, also known as DeepSeek\-V4\.1\-Flash\. It lets you send images with text prompts so the model can describe pictures\, read text from screenshots\, analyze charts\, inspect UI images\, and perform OCR\-like extraction\. It is not a separate model name you should call directly\.

For new API code\, usedeepseek\-flash for image input\. DeepSeek’s change log says the older V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp models are retired\, while deepseek\-v4\-flash and deepseek\-v4\-flash\-vision\-exp temporarily route to V4\.1 Flash for compatibility\. An accepted legacy name does not mean the retired model is still being served\.

The current model list also matters\:deepseek\-flash supports text and image input\, while deepseek\-v4\-pro is listed as text\-only\. That means deepseek\-v4\-pro should not be used for Vision requests unless DeepSeek changes the official model table in the future\. DeepSeek Lists Models API

This guide covers Base64\, external URLs\, uploaded image IDs\, detail settings\, image limits\, and billing\. It also separates Chat Completions\, Responses\, and Anthropic\-compatible request formats\: their message roles and image blocks are not interchangeable\.

\#\# DeepSeek Vision at a glance

Question \| Current answer 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
What is DeepSeek Vision\? \| DeepSeek’s hosted image\-input capability through deepseek\-flash\. 
Is there a model called deepseek\-vision\? \| No\. Use deepseek\-flash for current Vision API work\. 
Which model supports images\? \| deepseek\-flash\, listed as DeepSeek\-V4\.1\-Flash\. 
Does deepseek\-v4\-pro support image input\? \| No\, not in the current model table\. It is listed as text\-only\. 
Is deepseek\-v4\-flash\-vision\-exp current\? \| No\. It is a legacy compatibility name\; new code should use deepseek\-flash\. 
Supported image formats \| JPEG\, PNG\, GIF\, and WebP\. 
Main image input methods \| Base64 data URL\, external HTTP\(S\) URL\, or Files API file\_id\. 
Can it read screenshots\? \| Yes\, DeepSeek’s Vision docs describe screenshot text reading as a supported use case\. 
Is it the same as DeepSeek\-OCR\? \| No\. DeepSeek Vision is hosted API image understanding\; DeepSeek\-OCR\/OCR\-2 are local\/open\-weight OCR model routes\. 

\#\# What is DeepSeek Vision\?

DeepSeek Vision is the practical name developers use for DeepSeek’s image\-input API capability\. In official docs\, the actual model ID to use isdeepseek\-flash\. With this model\, you can combine text and images in one request and ask for visual understanding\, OCR\-like extraction\, chart analysis\, document triage\, UI inspection\, and image comparison\. DeepSeek Vision guide

Do not confuse “Vision” with a standalone model name\. You do not calldeepseek\-vision\. You call deepseek\-flash through the DeepSeek API and provide image content in the required request shape\. For creating images rather than analyzing them\, see whether DeepSeek can generate images\.

\#\# Which DeepSeek model supports image input\?

The current model table listsdeepseek\-flash as DeepSeek\-V4\.1\-Flash with input modalities of text and image\. It lists deepseek\-v4\-pro with input modality text only\. DeepSeek Lists Models API

Model name \| Current status \| Image input\? \| Use it for Vision\? 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
deepseek\-flash \| Current DeepSeek\-V4\.1\-Flash API model\. \| Yes\. \| Yes\. This is the current default for image\-input work\. 
deepseek\-v4\-pro \| Current Pro route in the model table\. \| No\, text\-only in the current table\. \| No\. 
deepseek\-v4\-flash\-vision\-exp \| Legacy\/retired compatibility name\. \| Requests are served by the latest Flash model according to DeepSeek’s Vision and V4\.1 Flash notes\. \| No\. Use deepseek\-flash in new code\. 
DeepSeek\-OCR \/ DeepSeek\-OCR\-2 \| Separate OCR\/document model route\. \| Not the hosted Vision API model name\. \| Use only when you specifically want local\/open\-weight OCR workflows\. 

\#\# What happened todeepseek\-v4\-flash\-vision\-exp\?

deepseek\-v4\-flash\-vision\-exp was an experimental image\-input route\. The Vision guide and change log say its name is still accepted for compatibility\, but requests are served by the newer Flash model\. Updating the model ID does not remove the need to use the correct image format for your endpoint\.

The practical migration is simple\:

Old tutorial says \| Use now \| Why 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
deepseek\-v4\-flash\-vision\-exp \| deepseek\-flash \| The old Vision experimental model is retired\; deepseek\-flash is the current model ID\. 
deepseek\-v4\-flash \| deepseek\-flash \| The old Flash model name is legacy compatibility context\. 
deepseek\-v4\-pro for images \| deepseek\-flash \| The current model table lists V4 Pro as text\-only\. 

\#\# What can DeepSeek Vision do\?

DeepSeek Vision is useful when your task needs the model to inspect visual content\. Common use cases include\:

\- Describe a photo or product image\.
\- Read visible text from a screenshot\.
\- Extract table text from an image\.
\- Analyze a chart\, graph\, or slide\.
\- Read labels from diagrams or UI screenshots\.
\- Extract fields from a receipt\, invoice\, or form\.
\- Compare two images and list visible differences\.
\- Ask whether a scanned page is legible enough for data extraction\.

For OCR\-like tasks\, treat the output as model\-generated extraction\, not a guaranteed transcript\. Tables\, small text\, handwriting\, low\-contrast scans\, rotated pages\, dense charts\, legal clauses\, medical images\, and financial records should be reviewed against the source image\.

\#\# Choose the message role and image format for your API

For a direct image question\,user is the consistent starting point across these examples\. The surrounding payload must still match the endpoint\.

API \| Direct image message \| Content format 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
Chat Completions \| role\: \"user\"\. Its documented message schema does not include developer\. \| text plus image\_url\, or a file block\. 
Responses \| user or developer\; DeepSeek treats developer as user\. \| input\_text plus input\_image\. 
Anthropic\-compatible Messages \| Use role\: \"user\" for the direct image example\. \| text plus image with a source object\. 

Sources\: Chat Completions schema\, Responses schema\, and Anthropic\-format image examples\. Changing onlyrole does not convert one API format into another\. DeepSeek’s acceptance of developer in Responses does not give it a separate\, higher\-priority instruction role\.

\#\#\# Images returned by tools are a separate path

At this review\, DeepSeek’s documentation is not fully consistent\: the Vision guide’s Restrictions section says images are supported only inuser messages\, while the Chat Completions schema also permits image\/file content in a tool message with a matching tool\_call\_id\. Keep direct uploads in user\; test the documented tool\-result path separately rather than asserting that all image\-bearing messages must be user messages\. Vision restrictions\; tool\-message schema\.

Responses explicitly documentsinput\_image inside function\_call\_output and supported custom\_tool\_call\_output items\. These are tool outputs with call\-ID pairing\, not a reason to use developer in Chat Completions\. See Responses image input\.

\#\# How to send images with Chat Completions

Forclient\.chat\.completions\.create\(\)\, use https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\, model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\, and a user message whose content is a list of blocks\. Put the image URL inside an image\_url object\; do not use the flat Responses input\_image shape\. Chat Completions reference\.

Install the OpenAI Python SDK and set a DeepSeek API key in the terminal running your script\. The SDK is the client\; DeepSeek receives and bills the requests\.
python \-m pip install openai
On macOS or Linux\:
export DEEPSEEK\_API\_KEY\=\"YOUR\_DEEPSEEK\_API\_KEY\"
On Windows PowerShell\:
\$env\:DEEPSEEK\_API\_KEY \= \"YOUR\_DEEPSEEK\_API\_KEY\"
Use a real JPEG namedscreenshot\.jpg for the local examples\. Match the MIME type when using another format\. The examples disable thinking and use a 2\,048\-token output budget to keep the first request bounded\; these are demonstration settings\, not image limits or guarantees of complete extraction\. For Chat Completions\, the OpenAI Python SDK sends the DeepSeek\-specific thinking field through extra\_body\; the other SDK examples use their own request controls\. Request options\.

\#\#\# Base64 image example in Python

Use Base64 when the image is local and small enough to fit inside the request body limit\.
import base64
import os
from pathlib import Path
from openai import OpenAI

image\_path \= Path\(\"screenshot\.jpg\"\)
image\_b64 \= base64\.b64encode\(image\_path\.read\_bytes\(\)\)\.decode\(\"ascii\"\)

with OpenAI\(
    api\_key\=os\.environ\[\"DEEPSEEK\_API\_KEY\"\]\,
    base\_url\=\"https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\"\,
\) as client\:
    response \= client\.chat\.completions\.create\(
        model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\,
        messages\=\[\{
            \"role\"\: \"user\"\,
            \"content\"\: \[
                \{\"type\"\: \"text\"\, \"text\"\: \"Read the visible text\. Preserve line breaks and mark unreadable text as unclear\.\"\}\,
                \{
                    \"type\"\: \"image\_url\"\,
                    \"image\_url\"\: \{
                        \"url\"\: f\"data\:image\/jpeg\;base64\,\{image\_b64\}\"\,
                        \"detail\"\: \"original\"\,
                    \}\,
                \}\,
            \]\,
        \}\]\,
        max\_tokens\=2048\,
        extra\_body\=\{\"thinking\"\: \{\"type\"\: \"disabled\"\}\}\,
    \)

if not response\.choices\:
    raise RuntimeError\(\"No response choice was returned\.\"\)
choice \= response\.choices\[0\]
if choice\.finish\_reason \!\= \"stop\" or not choice\.message\.content\:
    raise RuntimeError\(\"No complete text answer\; inspect the finish reason before using it\.\"\)
print\(choice\.message\.content\)

\#\#\# External image URL example

Use a reachable HTTP\(S\) URL for an image already approved for external access\. DeepSeek documents a maximum URL length of 8\,192 characters and a download timeout of 60 seconds\. Replace the placeholder below with an actual image URL\;example\.com\/chart\.png is not a working sample image\. Do not publish confidential images just to make a URL fetch work\. External\-image requirements\.
import os
from openai import OpenAI

image\_url \= \"https\:\/\/example\.com\/chart\.png\"  \# Replace with your real image URL\.
if image\_url \=\= \"https\:\/\/example\.com\/chart\.png\"\:
    raise ValueError\(\"Replace the placeholder with a reachable image URL\.\"\)

with OpenAI\(
    api\_key\=os\.environ\[\"DEEPSEEK\_API\_KEY\"\]\,
    base\_url\=\"https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\"\,
\) as client\:
    response \= client\.chat\.completions\.create\(
        model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\,
        messages\=\[\{
            \"role\"\: \"user\"\,
            \"content\"\: \[
                \{\"type\"\: \"text\"\, \"text\"\: \"Read the chart title\, axes\, legend\, and labeled values\. Do not invent unlabeled values\.\"\}\,
                \{\"type\"\: \"image\_url\"\, \"image\_url\"\: \{\"url\"\: image\_url\, \"detail\"\: \"original\"\}\}\,
            \]\,
        \}\]\,
        max\_tokens\=2048\,
        extra\_body\=\{\"thinking\"\: \{\"type\"\: \"disabled\"\}\}\,
    \)

if not response\.choices\:
    raise RuntimeError\(\"No response choice was returned\.\"\)
choice \= response\.choices\[0\]
if choice\.finish\_reason \!\= \"stop\" or not choice\.message\.content\:
    raise RuntimeError\(\"No complete text answer was returned\.\"\)
print\(choice\.message\.content\)

\#\#\# Files APIfile\_id example

Use the Files API when the same image will be reused across multiple requests\, when an inline Base64 request would exceed the request body limit\, or when the image is larger than the inline\/external image limit\. DeepSeek’s Vision guide says Files API image references can be used through afile content block with a file\_id like file\-api\-\.\.\.\. DeepSeek Files API
import os
from openai import OpenAI

with OpenAI\(
    api\_key\=os\.environ\[\"DEEPSEEK\_API\_KEY\"\]\,
    base\_url\=\"https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\"\,
\) as client\:
    with open\(\"screenshot\.jpg\"\, \"rb\"\) as image\:
        uploaded \= client\.files\.create\(file\=image\, purpose\=\"user\_data\"\)

    print\(\"Uploaded file ID\:\"\, uploaded\.id\)
    response \= client\.chat\.completions\.create\(
        model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\,
        messages\=\[\{
            \"role\"\: \"user\"\,
            \"content\"\: \[
                \{\"type\"\: \"text\"\, \"text\"\: \"Describe this image and list the visible text\. Mark unreadable text as unclear\.\"\}\,
                \{\"type\"\: \"file\"\, \"file\_id\"\: uploaded\.id\}\,
            \]\,
        \}\]\,
        max\_tokens\=2048\,
        extra\_body\=\{\"thinking\"\: \{\"type\"\: \"disabled\"\}\}\,
    \)

if not response\.choices\:
    raise RuntimeError\(\"No response choice was returned\.\"\)
choice \= response\.choices\[0\]
if choice\.finish\_reason \!\= \"stop\" or not choice\.message\.content\:
    raise RuntimeError\(\"No complete text answer was returned\.\"\)
print\(choice\.message\.content\)
In DeepSeek’s Chat Completions format\,file\_id is directly inside the file block\, as shown\. The alternative file\_data field contains an inline image data URL\; do not combine it with file\_id\. Uploaded files belong to the API key\. The example omits expiration\, so the file remains stored until deleted\; retain the returned ID for reuse and manage its lifecycle\. Files API reference\.

After all requests using the file have finished\, delete it withclient\.files\.delete\(file\_id\) using an active client and the saved ID\, or set a documented expiration at upload\. Reusing a stored file avoids repeated uploads\; it does not make model inference free\.

\#\# Image input methods\: which one should you use\?

Method \| Best for \| Limits and cautions 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
Base64 data URL in image\_url \| Local files in quick scripts and backend jobs\. \| Counts toward request body size\. Keep files small enough for inline use\. 
External HTTP\(S\) image URL \| Public images already hosted online\. \| URL must be at most 8192 characters\, and the image must be reachable by DeepSeek\. 
Files API file\_id \| Reusing the same image across requests or handling larger images\. \| Requires an upload step and file lifecycle management\. 
file\_data \| Inline image data inside a file block\. \| Mutually exclusive with file\_id\. 

\#\# Detail levels\:low\, high\, original\, and auto

Thedetail field controls how image URL inputs are processed\. DeepSeek’s Vision docs define these values\: low downsamples the image to 512×512 before inference\; high and original keep the original image\; auto is currently equivalent to original\. DeepSeek Vision guide

Detail value \| Behavior \| Use it when 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
low \| Downscales the image to 512×512\. \| You need a broad image description and do not need small text or fine details\. 
high \| Keeps the original image\; provided for compatibility\. \| You need detail and your code already uses high\. 
original \| Keeps the original image\. \| You need OCR\-like extraction\, chart labels\, UI text\, forms\, receipts\, or dense screenshots\. 
auto \| Currently equivalent to original\. \| You want the default high\-detail behavior while keeping the option for future automatic handling\. 

For dense screenshots or chart labels\, start withoriginal and check the extracted text\. This avoids the specific low downsampling step\, but does not bypass the model’s normal pre\-inference resizing\. For broad scene description\, test whether low is adequate instead of assuming more detail is always necessary\.

\#\# Image limits and token billing

DeepSeek’s Vision docs list shared image limits for Vision requests\. These limits matter because many image failures are caused by oversized files\, too many images\, or sending images in the wrong format\. DeepSeek Vision guide

Limit \| Current value 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
Supported formats \| JPEG\, PNG\, GIF\, WebP\. 
External URL length \| 8192 characters\. 
Request body size \| 48 MiB\. 
Max single image size\: Base64 \/ external URL \| 32 MiB\. 
Max single image size\: Files API file\_id \| 64 MiB\. 
Max images per request \| 600\. 
Max total image size per request \| 64 MiB without file\_id images\; up to 200 MiB including file\_id images\. 
Max image dimension \| 8192 px per side\; 4096 px per side when a request contains 15 or more images\. 

All applicable limits must be satisfied together\. Base64 increases the serialized body size\, so the image\-byte allowance is not the same as the 48 MiB JSON\-body allowance\. Afile\_id avoids embedding the image bytes in that body\, but does not remove image\-count\, dimension\, aggregate\-size\, or context limits\. Here\, MiB means 1\,048\,576 bytes\.

DeepSeek says images are converted into tokens based on dimensions and billed together with text tokens\. The Vision guide also says images are automatically resized before inference and that there is an upper bound of 1024 tokens per image after resizing\. Each image in a multi\-image request is counted independently\. DeepSeek Vision guide

Use the official image token calculator for estimates and response usage for actual billing\. Smaller files reduce transfer size\, but images already at the same post\-resize token cap need not become cheaper merely by reducing their source dimensions\. Compare detail settings\, image count\, and output length\, using current model prices\.

\#\# Using images with the Responses API

Forclient\.responses\.create\(\)\, use input\_text and input\_image\. Unlike Chat Completions\, the image URL is a string directly on the content part\. The example uses user\; DeepSeek also accepts developer here and treats it as user\. Responses compatibility guide\.
import base64
import os
from pathlib import Path
from openai import OpenAI

image\_b64 \= base64\.b64encode\(Path\(\"screenshot\.jpg\"\)\.read\_bytes\(\)\)\.decode\(\"ascii\"\)

with OpenAI\(
    api\_key\=os\.environ\[\"DEEPSEEK\_API\_KEY\"\]\,
    base\_url\=\"https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\"\,
\) as client\:
    response \= client\.responses\.create\(
        model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\,
        input\=\[\{
            \"role\"\: \"user\"\,
            \"content\"\: \[
                \{\"type\"\: \"input\_text\"\, \"text\"\: \"Describe the main visible elements\. Do not guess unreadable text\.\"\}\,
                \{
                    \"type\"\: \"input\_image\"\,
                    \"image\_url\"\: f\"data\:image\/jpeg\;base64\,\{image\_b64\}\"\,
                    \"detail\"\: \"low\"\,
                \}\,
            \]\,
        \}\]\,
        reasoning\=\{\"effort\"\: \"none\"\}\,
        max\_output\_tokens\=2048\,
    \)

if response\.status \!\= \"completed\" or not response\.output\_text\:
    raise RuntimeError\(\"The response is incomplete or has no final text\; inspect its status\.\"\)
print\(response\.output\_text\)
Choose exactly one source perinput\_image\: image\_url or file\_id\. DeepSeek documents HTTP 400 when both or neither are supplied\, or when an image appears in a system or assistant message\. detail is ignored for file\_id images\. Referenced images are supported\; that does not imply support for a generic PDF input\_file block\. Responses request reference\.

\#\# Using images with the Anthropic\-compatible API

\# 图像理解

deepseek\-flash 模型支持在文本之外输入图片，你可以让模型描述图片、识别截图中的文字、分析图表等。旧模型名 deepseek\-v4\-flash\-vision\-exp 仍可调用，但该模型已下线，其请求同样由最新的 Flash 模型承接。

支持的图片格式：JPEG、PNG、GIF、WebP。格式由文件实际内容判断，而非文件名或声明的 MIME 类型。

\#\# 传入图片

共有三种方式向模型提供图片，均使用标准的 OpenAI 兼容对话补全格式，即content 为一个块（block）数组，而非纯字符串。同样的三种方式也适用于 Responses API，图片以 input\_image 内容块承载。

以下示例的base\_url 为 https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com。

\#\#\# 1\. Base64 编码图片（内联）

将图片编码后以data\: URL 的形式直接嵌入请求。这是本地文件最简单的方式。编码后的数据会计入 48 MiB 请求体大小限制（见 限制）。
import base64
from openai import OpenAI

client \= OpenAI\(api\_key\=\"\<DeepSeek API Key\>\"\, base\_url\=\"https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\"\)

with open\(\"image\.jpg\"\, \"rb\"\) as f\:
    b64 \= base64\.b64encode\(f\.read\(\)\)\.decode\(\"utf\-8\"\)

response \= client\.chat\.completions\.create\(
    model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\,
    messages\=\[
        \{
            \"role\"\: \"user\"\,
            \"content\"\: \[
                \{\"type\"\: \"text\"\, \"text\"\: \"这张图片里有什么？\"\}\,
                \{
                    \"type\"\: \"image\_url\"\,
                    \"image\_url\"\: \{\"url\"\: f\"data\:image\/jpeg\;base64\,\{b64\}\"\}\,
                \}\,
            \]\,
        \}\,
    \]\,
\)
print\(response\.choices\[0\]\.message\.content\)
curl https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\/chat\/completions \\
  \-H \"Content\-Type\: application\/json\" \\
  \-H \"Authorization\: Bearer \<DeepSeek API Key\>\" \\
  \-d \'\{
    \"model\"\: \"deepseek\-flash\"\,
    \"messages\"\: \[
      \{
        \"role\"\: \"user\"\,
        \"content\"\: \[
          \{\"type\"\: \"text\"\, \"text\"\: \"这张图片里有什么？\"\}\,
          \{\"type\"\: \"image\_url\"\, \"image\_url\"\: \{\"url\"\: \"data\:image\/jpeg\;base64\,\<BASE64\_DATA\>\"\}\}
        \]
      \}
    \]
  \}\'

\#\#\# 2\. 外部图片 URL

传入一个可公开访问的http\(s\) 链接，模型会自动下载图片。URL 长度最多 8192 个字符，图片文件最大 32 MiB，且需在 60 秒内完成下载。如果链接超长，请改用 base64 data URL 或 Files API。
response \= client\.chat\.completions\.create\(
    model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\,
    messages\=\[
        \{
            \"role\"\: \"user\"\,
            \"content\"\: \[
                \{\"type\"\: \"text\"\, \"text\"\: \"描述一下这张图片。\"\}\,
                \{
                    \"type\"\: \"image\_url\"\,
                    \"image\_url\"\: \{\"url\"\: \"https\:\/\/example\.com\/image\.jpg\"\}\,
                \}\,
            \]\,
        \}\,
    \]\,

\#\#\# 3\. 引用通过 Files API 上传的文件

通过 Files API 上传一次图片，之后在请求中用其file\_id 引用。当你需要在多个请求中复用同一张图片，或图片会让请求体超过 48 MiB 内联限制时，这是最佳选择。与内联图片不同，通过 Files API file\_id 引用的图片最大可达 64 MiB，且不受 32 MiB 单图检查限制。

使用file 内容块，填入返回的 file\_id（形如 file\-api\-\.\.\.）：
response \= client\.chat\.completions\.create\(
    model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\,
    messages\=\[
        \{
            \"role\"\: \"user\"\,
            \"content\"\: \[
                \{\"type\"\: \"text\"\, \"text\"\: \"这张图片里有什么？\"\}\,
                \{\"type\"\: \"file\"\, \"file\_id\"\: \"file\-api\-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx\"\}\,
            \]\,
        \}\,
    \]\,
\)
print\(response\.choices\[0\]\.message\.content\)

此外，file 块也可以通过 file\_data 以 base64 形式内联携带图片（file\_data 与 file\_id 二者互斥）：
\{
  \"type\"\: \"file\"\,
  \"file\_data\"\: \"data\:image\/jpeg\;base64\,\<BASE64\_DATA\>\"\,
  \"filename\"\: \"image\.jpg\"
\}

\#\# 细节级别（Detail Level）

对于image\_url 输入，你可以选填 detail 字段来控制图片的处理方式：

取值 \| 行为 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
low \| 推理前将图片缩放到 512×512。当不需要精细视觉细节时更快、更省 token。 
high \| 保留原图。（为兼容性提供，等价于 original。） 
original \| 保留原图。 
auto \| 自动选择。当前等价于 original。 

\{
  \"type\"\: \"image\_url\"\,
  \"image\_url\"\: \{\"url\"\: \"https\:\/\/example\.com\/image\.jpg\"\, \"detail\"\: \"low\"\}
\}

\#\# 何时使用 Files API

内联图片（base64 或file\_data）会计入 48 MiB 的请求体大小限制。以下情况建议使用 Files API：

\- 单个请求会超过请求体大小限制。
\- 图片超过 32 MiB（只有通过 Files API 才能使用）。
\- 你在多个请求中引用同一张图片，希望避免每次重复上传。

\#\# Token 用量

图片会根据其尺寸换算成 token，并与文本 token 一起计费。

在进入模型前，每张图片都会被自动缩放：

\- 总像素小于约 544×544 的图片会被保持长宽比放大；
\- 更大的图片会被保持长宽比缩小，缩小后的总像素约相当于 1300×1300 的图片。

因此，每张图片消耗的 token 数存在上限（1024 个）：例如 2000×2000 和 5000×5000 的图片，经缩放后消耗的 token 数是相同的。单个请求包含多张图片时，每张图片独立按同一规则计算，不存在额外的计算方式。

如需估算具体尺寸图片的 token 消耗，请使用 Token 与用量计算 页面的图片 Token 计算器。

\#\# 在 Anthropic API 中使用图片

除了上面的 OpenAI 兼容端点，你也可以通过 Anthropic 兼容的\/messages 端点发送图片（base\_url 为 https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\/anthropic）。基础配置请参考 Anthropic API。

区别在于图片内容块的结构。Anthropic 不使用image\_url，而是使用 image 块，其 source 对象的 type 为 base64、url 或 file 之一：
import anthropic

client \= anthropic\.Anthropic\(\)  \# ANTHROPIC\_BASE\_URL\=https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\/anthropic

message \= client\.messages\.create\(
    model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\,
    max\_tokens\=1024\,
    messages\=\[
        \{
            \"role\"\: \"user\"\,
            \"content\"\: \[
                \{\"type\"\: \"text\"\, \"text\"\: \"这张图片里有什么？\"\}\,
                \{
                    \"type\"\: \"image\"\,
                    \"source\"\: \{
                        \"type\"\: \"base64\"\,
                        \"media\_type\"\: \"image\/jpeg\"\,
                        \"data\"\: \"\<BASE64\_DATA\>\"\,
                    \}\,
                \}\,
            \]\,
        \}\,
    \]\,
\)
print\(message\.content\)

三种source 变体与上面的 OpenAI 方式一一对应：

\# 使用 Responses API

为了满足大家对 Codex 的需求，我们的 API 新增了对 Responses API 格式的支持，其base\_url 为 https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com。

通过简单的配置，即可在 Codex 中使用 DeepSeek 模型。

\#\# 将 DeepSeek 模型接入 Codex

请参考接入 Codex

\#\# 通过 Responses API 调用 DeepSeek 模型
\# Please install OpenAI SDK first\: \`pip3 install openai\`
from openai import OpenAI

client \= OpenAI\(api\_key\=\"\<your DeepSeek API Key\>\"\, base\_url\=\"https\:\/\/api\.deepseek\.com\"\)

response \= client\.responses\.create\(
    model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\,
    instructions\=\"You are a helpful assistant\.\"\,
    input\=\"Hi\, how are you\?\"\,
\)

print\(response\.output\_text\)

\#\# 流式输出

设置stream\: true，响应将以语义化的流式 SSE 事件序列返回。每个事件带有表示事件类型的 event 字段和递增的 sequence\_number。流以 response\.completed \/ response\.incomplete \/ response\.failed 事件结束，没有 data\: \[DONE\] 消息。
stream \= client\.responses\.create\(
    model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\,
    instructions\=\"You are a helpful assistant\.\"\,
    input\=\"Hi\, how are you\?\"\,
    stream\=True\,
\)

for event in stream\:
    if event\.type \=\= \"response\.output\_text\.delta\"\:
        print\(event\.delta\, end\=\"\"\)

完整事件列表：

事件 \| 说明 
\-\-\-\|\-\-\-
response\.created \| 首个事件；响应已创建，状态为 in\_progress 
response\.in\_progress \| 响应正在生成中 
response\.output\_item\.added \/ response\.output\_item\.done \| 一个输出 item（reasoning \/ message \/ function\_call \/ custom\_tool\_call \/ web\_search\_call \/ tool\_search\_call）开始 \/ 完成 
response\.content\_part\.added \/ response\.content\_part\.done \| 输出 item 中的一个内容块开始 \/ 完成 
response\.reasoning\_text\.delta \/ response\.reasoning\_text\.done \| 思维链文本增量 \/ 完整思维链文本 
response\.output\_text\.delta \/ response\.output\_text\.done \| 输出文本增量 \/ 完整输出文本 
response\.function\_call\_arguments\.delta \/ response\.function\_call\_arguments\.done \| Function 调用参数增量 \/ 完整参数 
response\.custom\_tool\_call\_input\.delta \/ response\.custom\_tool\_call\_input\.done \| Custom 工具调用（apply\_patch）输入增量 \/ 完整输入 
response\.web\_search\_call\.in\_progress \/ response\.web\_search\_call\.searching \/ response\.web\_search\_call\.completed \| 服务端 web\_search 调用开始 \/ 搜索中 \/ 完成（仅 deepseek\-v4\-pro） 
response\.completed \| 响应正常完成时的最后一个事件，携带包含 usage 的完整 response 对象 
response\.incomplete \| 响应被截断（如达到 max\_output\_tokens）时的最后一个事件，携带完整 response 对象 
response\.failed \| 响应失败时的最后一个事件，携带含 error 详情的完整 response 对象 

\#\# 图片输入

Responses API 支持使用deepseek\-flash 模型传入图片，适用的图片限制与支持格式与对话补全一致。

图片通过message item 中的 input\_image 内容块提供，使用 image\_url（http\(s\) URL 或 base64 data URL）或 file\_id（通过 Files API 上传的图片）二者之一：
response \= client\.responses\.create\(
    model\=\"deepseek\-flash\"\,
    input\=\[
        \{
            \"role\"\: \"user\"\,
            \"content\"\: \[
                \{\"type\"\: \"input\_text\"\, \"text\"\: \"这张图片里有什么？\"\}\,
                \{\"type\"\: \"input\_image\"\, \"image\_url\"\: \"https\:\/\/example\.com\/image\.jpg\"\, \"detail\"\: \"low\"\}\,
            \]\,
        \}\,
    \]\,
\)
print\(response\.output\_text\)

input\_image 内容块也可以出现在 function\_call\_output \/ custom\_tool\_call\_output item 的 output 中，让模型接收你的工具生成的图片：
input\=\[
    \{\"role\"\: \"user\"\, \"content\"\: \"读取工具返回的截图。\"\}\,
    \{\"type\"\: \"function\_call\"\, \"call\_id\"\: \"fc1\"\, \"name\"\: \"take\_screenshot\"\, \"arguments\"\: \"\{\}\"\}\,
    \{\"type\"\: \"function\_call\_output\"\, \"call\_id\"\: \"fc1\"\,
     \"output\"\: \[\{\"type\"\: \"input\_image\"\, \"image\_url\"\: \"data\:image\/png\;base64\,\<BASE64\_DATA\>\"\}\]\}\,
\]

\#\#\# input\_image 字段

\- image\_url：图片的 http\(s\) URL（最多 8192 个字符）或 base64 编码的 data URL（data\:image\/jpeg\;base64\,\.\.\.）。支持的格式：JPEG、PNG、GIF、WebP。
\- file\_id：通过 Files API 上传的图片文件 ID，形如 file\-api\-\.\.\.。
\- detail：low \/ high \/ original \/ auto。low 在推理前将图片缩小到 512x512；其余取值保留原图。设置 file\_id 时被忽略。

image\_url 与 file\_id 互斥：两者都不传返回 400 错误（\"input\_image must have image\_url or file\_id\"），两者都传返回 400 错误（\"input\_image cannot have both image\_url and file\_id\"）。

\#\#\# 使用限制

\- 图片仅允许出现在user \/ developer 消息 item 以及 function\_call\_output \/ custom\_tool\_call\_output 的输出中；system \/ assistant 消息中的图片会返回 400 错误。
\- deepseek\-flash 会真正处理 input\_image 内容块。
\- 与对话补全相同的图片限制（内联单张 32 MiB、file\_id 单张 64 MiB、不含 file\_id 图片总计 64 MiB，含 file\_id 图片最高 200 MiB、单请求 600 张等）同样适用，详见图像理解：限制。

answerBlocks.text: 当前模型 ID：官方文档与示例代码一致使用 deepseek-flash 作为调用名，可视为当前模型 ID；但第三方网关页提到存在“新的官方模型名”且列出 deepseek-v4.1-flash、deepseek-v4-flash 等别名，摘录未说明其与当前 ID 的完整对应关系。
旧别名区分：deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 是已下线的旧视觉实验模型名，仍可调用但请求由最新 Flash 承接；deepseek-v4-flash 被第三方页描述为稳定公共别名（文本请求路由到 V4.1）。这些均不同于当前 ID deepseek-flash。
图片输入：deepseek-flash 支持图片输入（描述图片、识别截图文字、分析图表），可通过 base64 data URL、外部 http(s) URL、Files API file_id 三种方式传入，也可经 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 以 input_image 内容块传入；受内联 48 MiB、file_id 64 MiB、单图 32 MiB 等限制。
